extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML mechanism sections, Figure 4/5 captions, and methods sections; automated pending-review placeholders replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D2D shows rapid killing against MRSP C22963 in the time-kill assay, reaching below the detection threshold at 1x MIC within 30 min in the reported experiment.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=12:2.5.1 Time-Kill Kinetics of D2D; xml:fig=3

mechanism_claims.limitations: Regrowth after 24 h is noted by the figure caption; the claim is limited to the reported time-kill conditions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At sub-MIC concentration, DiSC3(5) fluorescence supports membrane-potential effects for D2, D2L, and D2R, while D2D has the lowest PMF activity among the tested analogues.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: D2, D2D, D2L, D2R in MRSP E104 membrane-potential assay

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=16:2.7; xml:fig=4; xml:sec=30:Studying Bacterial Membrane Potential

mechanism_claims.limitations: Sub-MIC PMF behavior is not treated as direct proof of high-concentration lysis for every analogue.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Macromolecule biosynthesis assays show D2D as the strongest inhibitor among the D2 analogues for DNA and cell-wall precursor incorporation under the reported sub-MIC conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: D2D, D2L, D2R, D2 in MRSP E104 macromolecule assay

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=19:2.7.3 Macromolecule Biosynthesis Assay; xml:fig=5; xml:sec=32

mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports pathway-level inhibition under sub-MIC exposure; it does not identify a single molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Worker-6 adjudication preserves the paper conclusion that D2D is membrane inactive at sub-MIC concentration and is consistent with intracellular DNA/cell-wall synthesis effects, while leaving receptor-binding speculation as unresolved.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Chiral receptor binding is explicitly not promoted to a verified direct mechanism.

summary.caution: Mechanism is bounded to time-kill, PMF fluorescence, and macromolecule-biosynthesis assays; no unsupported receptor-level target is asserted.
